parameters.assumption_rationale: Each site ID appears once after excluding sites with multiple provenance-source labels; at least five eligible matchups are required per site. Under the narrow null of identical empirical distributions of site-level proportions in the two selected source groups, site-level values are exchangeable for a descriptive permutation comparison. Geographic, temporal, waterbody and field-method confounding prevents any causal source effect or population inference; the p-value is exploratory only and spatial dependence may remain.

limitations: Single prespecified outcome; no family of tests.
Percentile bootstrap CI can have poor coverage for small/skewed samples.
Permutation inference assumes exchangeability; this is declared, not proven by software.
Association is not causation. Existing-data analysis is exploratory unless independently preregistered.
